meta_description: Evidence once, audit anywhere — compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.

blocks.x: Evidence once, audit anywhere — compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.

Compliance dies by spreadsheet: controls tracked in documents, evidence gathered in panic, audits consuming quarters. We implement compliance-as-code — controls expressed once in a framework-agnostic register, tested continuously against your systems, mapped automatically to SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS 4.0, DORA and GDPR/CCPA obligations. Evidence is collected by the platform, not by interns.

For financial-sector clients we extend into operational resilience regimes (DORA: ICT risk, incident reporting, third-party oversight; FCA/PRA operational resilience in the UK), and for anyone handling cards into PCI DSS 4.0 specifics — tokenization architecture, network segmentation evidence, and the new continuous-compliance expectations. The outcome is simple: audits become sampling exercises against a live control plane.
